title: Cache one consistent rational teacher while respecting zero-support queries
statement: Memoize one independent empirical row batch per visited positive-Q prefix. The first zero-count edge permanently switches that empirical path to uniform continuation, so every ORIGINAL-Q query follows an actually observed positive-count path even outside the accuracy event. Mix the acquired law globally with uniform and use its exact rational joint/prefix values; tiny requested digits concern this acquired law, not statistical knowledge of unknown tiny Q probabilities. One fixed lazy table defines one law and is independent of P/feature/token randomness.
